summary: Sea Ltd filed a Form 6-K to report its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing is an earnings release summarizing GAAP revenue of $7.1 billion, up 46.6% year-on-year, net income of $438.2 million, and segment updates for Shopee, Monee, and Garena. No special-situations transaction is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic report of financial performance. The company highlights organic growth, AI integration, and guidance for Shopee GMV growth of ~25% year-on-year. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or capital returns events. The filing is a standard earnings announcement without any M&A, restructuring, or shareholder-rights catalyst.
